references.text: The right of redemption for property is a central theme in both texts. Here in Leviticus 25, the general rules for redeeming land that has been sold are described.
The same principle of adding one-fifth upon redemption applies to animals dedicated to the Lord.
The addition of one-fifth upon redemption is also mentioned for houses dedicated to the Lord.
The one-fifth that must be added upon redemption also applies to the tithe of the land.
The principle of adding one-fifth when making restitution or redeeming holy things is established here.
The one-fifth addition when making restitution for guilt against the Lord confirms the same principle.
The right of redemption (gaal) is an important theme in the book of Ruth, where the kinsman has the right to redeem property.
